title: Single-coordinate product noise operator
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and choose a coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a real parameter $\rho$. The single-coordinate product noise transform of $f$ is the sum of its projection onto functions independent of coordinate $i$ and $\rho$ times its product-coordinate Laplacian in coordinate $i$.
